description: This file defines the EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator class, which is a decorator for the EmpUsTaxExemption entity in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to set employee references and retrieve state names related to tax exemptions using a country service.

classes.name: EmpUsTaxExemptionDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpUsTaxExemption entity, providing additional methods to interact with related entities such as Employee and geographical states through a country service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific EmpUsTaxExemption entity.

methods.name: getEmpUsTaxExemption
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying EmpUsTaxExemption entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee reference on the tax exemption entity based on an employee number.

methods.name: getTaxState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the tax state using the state code from the tax exemption entity.

methods.name: getUnemploymentState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the unemployment state using the state code from the tax exemption entity.

methods.name: getWorkState
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the work state using the state code from the tax exemption entity.
